method: Read-only AST import graph; full function/conditional imports provide conservative static closure, eager closure traverses module/class/if/try scopes and excludes function/lambda bodies. Dynamic file imports handled for current training adapters plus all sibling sources of active entrypoints. No GPU model/run executed.
limitations: Static closure is not a proven runtime-minimal set: dynamic string loaders and future data-dependent branches need end-to-end smoke coverage before a new source manifest can be made smaller.
Every existing root.py remains strictly protected for current run resume and pending validators regardless of static closure membership.
Do not replace moved root files by symlinks: code_hashes resolves paths and hashes dictionary keys would change.
